question: Evaluate the magnetic field distribution inside a Toroid of inner radius $R_1$ and outer radius $R_2$. Is the magnetic field uniform throughout the core volume?

options.A: Yes, it is uniform and equal to $\mu_0 n I$.
options.B: No, it varies inversely with distance $r$ from the center ($B \propto 1/r$).
options.C: No, it varies linearly with distance $r$ from the center ($B \propto r$).
options.D: Yes, but only if the cross-section is circular.
